body:
Checked all gene products of Non-collagenous component of basement membrane (GO:0140144) in AmiGO 2026/10/20, found 47 genes not listed in the final version of request in #6254 

All genes belong to non-collagenous component of interstitial matrix (GO:0140149), should be removed.

**I have put the genes need to be removed in this excel the same format as the excel spreadsheet**
